kicker: Storyline · The golden age · Forum threads
title: Season 100
dek: SmallBall's hundredth season, at the top of its run. Commish was posting puzzles, handing out free Deluxe Trainers and building a brand-new park, and the forum wrote poetry about it.
stats: Alice's Park, won by cracking a code

chapters.title: Crack the Code
chapters.text: Commish posts a page of clues that spell out the ticket code for an Alice's Park stadium. LarryB cracks it overnight. Yankee Dude got it at the same moment and missed by a hair.
quotes: I was pretty sure this one would last at least a day... guess not. Harder one next
Commish, can you move to the Eastern time zone?

chapters.title: Write for the HPN
chapters.text: Commish wants Home Plate News content for the Season 100 issue and has received exactly one submission. He sweetens the deal with a reward that doesn't exist yet: the rare Earth Elemental stadium. The submissions pour in, and the submission email starts bouncing them back.

chapters.title: Only one season left!
chapters.text: Commish counts down, and the forum takes roll. LCD has been around since day 2 of Season 30. ERG joined in Season 49. Cliff first made the ProLeague in Season 29.

chapters.title: 'Twas the night before Season 100
chapters.text: ERG writes the Christmas poem version, with the schedules set with care and players nestled all snug in their DTs. Issued-Away answers with his own, starring a boasting Chippy.
quotes: Not a Mod was stirring, not even little Chippy

chapters.title: A free Deluxe Trainer for everyone
chapters.text: Commish posts a free DT code good for Season 100 only. The catch: you have to type it in every day. The thread fills with complaints until matthew216 teaches everyone copy and paste.
quotes: For your FREE DT! This season only!

chapters.title: The Season 100 badge
chapters.text: The season closes with a surprise: a commemorative badge and a prize ticket in everyone's inbox. Slip'N'Sliders keeps the giving going with a free ticket of his own.
quotes: But the giving dont stop here...

chapters.title: Centennial Park opens
chapters.text: The commemorative stadium goes on sale (spelled "Cenntenial" in the announcement), alongside a new Box Score ticket. mcgov orders five and has them in under a minute. Beaner warns the park plays smaller than it looks.
quotes: Did someone get hit by a car past the right field wall?

chapters.title: The 12 Days of SmallBall Christmas
chapters.text: Lancer starts a giveaway thread with a Centennial stadium ticket. BP adds two mystery tickets. Beaner gives away so much that the thread names him BeanerClaus.

note: Quotes are kept short and posts are summarized. Old ticket codes from these threads are left out. Real names and contact details are left out on purpose.
